$schema_note: Frozen Wave 0 baseline for the style-violation ratchet (#121). The budgets in VIOLATION_BUDGET.json must never exceed these values: CI fails (tests/test_style_budget.py) if any budget is raised above its baseline, or if a metric is added or removed without updating this file in the same PR. Raising a baseline value is a deliberate, reviewable act: change this file in the same PR, record the change in 'history' below, and state the reason in the PR body. This file is not hash-locked or signed; the test only compares values, so a simultaneous edit of budget and baseline still passes CI and relies on human review of the diff. When re-baselining, update frozen_at / frozen_commit / reverified_at together and say which kind of change it is: a measurement correction (the counter was wrong, e.g. candidate 11(c)) or a real regression (code got worse). Lowering a budget does not require touching this file. Baseline values were measured with resilimes.design.violations.count_violations() at the #124 merge commit f53b88c3 and re-verified equal at 9b7585fe; spacing was re-measured with the corrected counter (11(c)) at main 0b821991.

history.reason: Wave 0 freeze; values measured with count_violations() at the #124 merge commit.

Not a regression: no CSS changed in this PR, only the ruler; the other six metrics were not re-measured at 0b821991, only spacing was (see notes).
